scope: Manual Previous/Next navigation, session isolation, native sequence order and asynchronous completion guards.
boundary: Browser tests exercise the real React App and PlayerPage with trusted Playwright remote/pointer input.
Media decoding and API responses are controlled fixtures. All non-development-server HTTP and WebSocket requests are intercepted.
No television, real account interaction, real stream decoding or actual playback-network quality is claimed by this evidence.
Manual transport starts from zero. Explicit selection and automatic episode advance retain their existing entry semantics.
Only test case labels, counts and source hashes are retained. Account data, network addresses and video titles are omitted.

results.failure: Previous remained disabled after Next; waiting for the control to become enabled timed out.

notes: The baseline contains one intentionally reproduced failing regression; it is not included in the 43 passing post-fix cases.
Browser total 18 consists of a complete 17-case run plus one separately run same-video re-entry callback guard case, not a single 18-case run.

The full-run label about the player remaining mounted refers to the same App instance; different video keys remount PlayerPage. The separate same-video guard case specifically retains the PlayerPage key.
Source hashes were unchanged within both browser runs, and both post-fix browser runs used identical production hashes.
